evaluate_failure_policy: No automatic rerun; the marker evaluation_fold_<k>.opened stays. Record sacct (State, ExitCode, Elapsed, NodeList), logs/smash-train_<J>_4294967294.out with its traceback, the marker content, whether evaluate_bundles/evaluate_<J>_single and receipts/evaluate_<J>_single.json exist (a partial bundle is never extracted), and the phase reached (traceback frame or progress probes). Phases: (a) marker created, test not read (prepare-bundle hash, EACCES after the last wait); (b) test packs read, not scored (load_packs, /tmp space, hash mismatch); (c) scored, not published (load_dcm, CUDA, TIMEOUT, CSV or metric loop, sha256sum -c, publish). In (a)-(c) no test number leaves the node: evaluate prints nothing and $WORK/output stays in node /tmp. Report to the user, who alone may authorise renaming the marker to evaluation_fold_<k>.opened.void_<J> and one identical rerun on another node. If the log shows publish "copied" lines, first try to recover $WORK/output from that node. A published evaluation is never rerun. A code or hash failure needs a new package, smoke and preflight.
